run_fwd_cxx_compile: run fwd.py with cxx to compile a C++ source file using the Windows cl compiler
run_fwd_ld_link: run fwd.py with ld to link object files into an executable using the Windows link tool
run_fwd_ar_archive: run fwd.py with ar to create a static library using the Windows lib tool
run_fwd_cxxpp_preprocess: run fwd.py with cxxpp to preprocess a C++ source file using the Windows cl compiler
review_fwd_executables_mapping: review the fwd.py executables dictionary that maps generic build tool names to Windows equivalents
